_comment: RigCheck by ShackDesk — COM ports whose name contains any of these (case-insensitive) are classified as that DeviceClass and never opened by Find my radio. Stray bytes to a rotator, amplifier, or antenna controller are a real-world hazard, and GPS pucks and Bluetooth links are never a radio CAT port. The operator can still tick such a port by hand. The same classes will drive future device-specific discovery (rotators, GPS, loggers) with their own protocol families. Add entries by pull request — see CONTRIBUTING.md.
